lppsa.verified_answer: For this simulator run, the verified project fixture confirms Pearlmont Phase 1 accepts LPPSA applications from applicants who meet LPPSA terms. This confirms the financing route is accepted by the project; it does not confirm your personal eligibility or approval, which only LPPSA can determine. The supplied reference effective 4 October 2026 lists up to RM1,000,000 maximum financing eligibility, 4.00% up to RM750,000 and 4.50% only on the portion above RM750,000, subject to LPPSA terms. Its 90% margin note applies when a first LPPSA financing remains active; since you have no active LPPSA financing, that condition does not describe your case. No approval is guaranteed.
